activeRecallQuiz.scenario: On a 3-box reversal chart with a ₹5 box size, a stock is in an ascending column of X's at ₹650. What is the exact price drop required to print an O column, and how many O's will appear at once?
activeRecallQuiz.question: On a 3-box reversal chart with a ₹5 box size, a stock is in an ascending column of X's at ₹650. What is the exact price drop required to print an O column, and how many O's will appear at once?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Price must drop by at least ₹15 (3 boxes × ₹5) to ₹635. Exactly 3 O's will be plotted simultaneously in the new column to the right (at ₹645, ₹640, and ₹635). Any drop less than ₹15 is completely ignored.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.
